title: Precise structure manipulation of selective estrogen receptor modulators led to first-in-class thiophene-3-benzamide derivatives as potential ER-antagonists without uterotrophic activity.
authors: Huwaimel, Bader; Abouzied, Amr S; Emwas, Abdul-Hamid; Ahmed, Al-Shaimaa F; El-Nagar, Mohamed K S; Mohammed, Hamdoon A; Alrashidi, Nader M; Alrashidi, Marwan A; Alshammari, Rakan E; Albladi, Abdulelah Y; Alqarni, Saad; Kassab, Shaymaa E
one_liner_zh: 该研究设计靶向雌激素受体的配体并利用分子对接和MD模拟解释拮抗活性，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法虽含物理模拟但与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: The present study introduces two sets of compounds: panel A, which features thiophene-3-benzamide, and panel B, which includes pyrazole-4-benzamide. We designed these compounds to target estrogen receptors (ER) while minimizing uterotrophic activities. The chemical structures of the two panels have been derived from structural modifications of the selective estrogen modulator, methyl-piperidinopyrazole (MPP). These modifications aim to reduce uterotrophic effects. In our design, we incorporated amide, amine, and ketone spacers between the three phenyl rings, substituting the central thiophene and pyrazole rings in the target ER antagonists. This structural strategy aims to alter the formation of tris-p-phenol metabolites, which are associated with the potential estrogenic activity of this class of compounds. The cytotoxicity of the compounds from panel A revealed significant activity against MCF7 cells, which are estrogen-dependent breast cancer cells. Importantly, these compounds demonstrated minimal cytotoxicity against other cell lines, including skin, osteosarcoma, and triple-negative breast cancer. Among the compounds tested, 5-benzoyl-thiophene-3-carboxamide 5a and 5-(4-chlorobenzoyl)-thiophene-3-carboxamide 5d exhibited the highest cytotoxicity against MCF7 cells, with IC(50) values of 7.38 muM and 8.50 muM, respectively. Furthermore, both 5a and 5d showed potential as antiestrogens, exhibiting no estrogenic activity in the uterine tissues of immature rats. In the dose-response experiment, the 5d antiestrogenic potency (EC(50) = 5.530 muM) was comparable to that of Tamoxifen (EC(50) = 7.625 muM). Molecular Docking and Molecular Dynamics simulations elucidated the antiestrogenic activity of 5d and inactivity of 5-fluorobenzoyl counterpart, 5e. The inactive derivative 5e in the active site exhibited an unfavorable conformation and unstable drug-receptor complex formation.
abstract_zh: 本研究引入了两组化合物：A组包含噻吩-3-苯甲酰胺，B组包含吡唑-4-苯甲酰胺。我们设计这些化合物以靶向雌激素受体（ER），同时最小化子宫营养活性。两组的化学结构源自选择性雌激素调节剂甲基哌啶吡唑（MPP）的结构修饰。这些修饰旨在降低子宫营养效应。在我们的设计中，我们在三个苯环之间引入了酰胺、胺和酮间隔基，取代了目标ER拮抗剂中的中心噻吩和吡唑环。这一结构策略旨在改变三对酚代谢物的形成，这些代谢物与该类化合物潜在的雌激素活性相关。A组化合物的细胞毒性显示对MCF7细胞（雌激素依赖性乳腺癌细胞）具有显著活性。重要的是，这些化合物对其他细胞系（包括皮肤、骨肉瘤和三阴性乳腺癌）表现出最小细胞毒性。在测试的化合物中，5-苯甲酰基-噻吩-3-甲酰胺5a和5-(4-氯苯甲酰基)-噻吩-3-甲酰胺5d对MCF7细胞表现出最高细胞毒性，其IC(50)值分别为7.38 μM和8.50 μM。此外，5a和5d均显示出作为抗雌激素剂的潜力，在未成熟大鼠子宫组织中无雌激素活性。在剂量反应实验中，5d的抗雌激素效力（EC(50) = 5.530 μM）与他莫昔芬（EC(50) = 7.625 μM）相当。分子对接和分子动力学模拟阐明了5d的抗雌激素活性及5-氟苯甲酰基对应物5e的无活性。无活性衍生物5e在活性位点中表现出不利构象和不稳定的药物-受体复合物形成。
